newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SUPERSPORT SERIES CLOSE OF PLAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of Supersport series matches on Saturday.
In Centurion: Natal 360 (Errol Stewart 78, Neil Johnson 69, Steve Elworthy 4-71) and 45-1; Northerns 121 (Gary Gilder 5-57, Tertius Bosch 4-19).
In Johannesburg: Transvaal 308 (Neil McKenzie 80, Dean Laing 76, Adam Bacher 58, Claude Henderson 5-107, Roger Telemachus 4-71), Boland 123-7.
In Bloemfontein: Western Province 446 all out (Jacques Kallis 143, Dave Rundle 81 not out, Alan Dawson 59, Sven Koenig 52), Free State 172-5 (Gerhardus Liebenberg 54 not out).
In Port Elizabeth: Eastern Province 476 for six declared (Louis Koen 186, Dave Callaghan 102, Mark Rushmere 63), Griqualand West 234-6 (Mickey Arthur 86)
